recognize_zh: 低倍（4x）TRAP 染色的骨髓切片，骨小梁之間散布許多成群、斑塊狀的深棕色陽性區域，對應 Gaucher 細胞的間質性浸潤；其餘造血組織呈藍色陰性。
features: Low-power trephine core with thin bony trabeculae
Multifocal patchy and confluent clusters of brown TRAP-positive cells throughout the intertrabecular spaces
Intervening TRAP-negative hematopoietic marrow with blue counterstain
Positive clusters distributed interstitially rather than along bone surfaces
Individual cell morphology not resolvable at 4x
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy stained for tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase shows multifocal interstitial clusters and sheets of TRAP-positive cells distributed throughout the intertrabecular marrow, separated by TRAP-negative hematopoietic tissue. The positive cells are not confined to bone surfaces, arguing against osteoclasts. Cytologic detail is not assessable at this magnification. In correlation with H&E and PAS morphology, findings are consistent with extensive Gaucher cell infiltration.

ddx.vs: HCL shows a diffuse interstitial TRAP-positive infiltrate of small monotonous cells with fried-egg halos and reticulin fibrosis, confirmed by CD20, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Osteoclasts are TRAP positive but line trabecular surfaces with associated bone remodeling rather than forming interstitial sheets.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells may be TRAP positive and require assessment of the underlying marrow disease and glucocerebrosidase activity.
